LEGAL NOTICE UNDER SECTIONS 15 AND 16 OF THE MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES DEVELOPMENT ACT, 2006

Sir / Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, M/s GANESH STEEL COMPONENTS, a proprietary concern of Mr. Bhavesh Ratilal Vora, having its works at 41, Bhaktinagar Industrial Area, Rajkot 360002, Gujarat, registered as a Small Enterprise (manufacturing) under the MSMED Act, 2006 with Udyam Registration No. UDYAM-GJ-20-0012345, (hereinafter "my client"), I hereby serve you with the following notice.

1. That my client manufactures and supplies precision turned components and has been supplying goods to you since August 2025 against your purchase orders. My client holds a valid Udyam Registration Certificate, which was furnished to you before the first order.

2. That the goods supplied under your purchase order Nos. JHE/PO/25-26/0821 and JHE/PO/25-26/1104 were duly delivered and accepted by you, as evidenced by delivery challans, e-way bills and goods received notes. You have never disputed the quality or quantity of the goods, nor returned any consignment.

3. That the payment terms agreed between the parties were thirty (30) days from the date of acceptance of goods. Since no written agreement specifies a longer period, the payment, in any case, was due within the period of forty-five (45) days from the day of acceptance in terms of Section 15 of the MSMED Act, 2006. The following invoices remain wholly unpaid:

Invoice No.      Invoice Date       Amount (Rs)    Due Date (45 days)    Interest accrued up to 15.10.2026 (Rs)
INV/25-26/118    12 Dec 2025        3,40,000       26 Jan 2026           42,900
INV/25-26/142    20 Jan 2026        2,85,000       5 Mar 2026            30,200
INV/25-26/177    18 Feb 2026        2,60,000       4 Apr 2026            23,700
INV/25-26/203    10 Mar 2026        2,35,000       24 Apr 2026           18,800
Total principal                     11,20,000                            1,15,600

4. That despite my client's reminders by emails dated 3 February 2026, 17 April 2026 and 9 June 2026, you have failed to pay. Your last communication dated 21 July 2026 admitted the liability and stated that payment would be made "shortly", which amounts to an acknowledgement of liability under Section 18 of the Limitation Act, 1963.

5. That under Section 15 of the MSMED Act, 2006, where a supplier supplies any goods or renders any services to any buyer, the buyer shall make payment on or before the date agreed upon in writing between him and the supplier or, where there is no agreement in this behalf, before the appointed day, and the period agreed upon in writing shall not exceed forty-five (45) days from the day of acceptance or the day of deemed acceptance.

6. That under Section 16 of the said Act, where any buyer fails to make payment of the amount to the supplier as required under Section 15, the buyer shall, notwithstanding anything contained in any agreement between the buyer and the supplier or in any law for the time being in force, be liable to pay compound interest with monthly rests to the supplier on that amount from the appointed day or, as the case may be, from the date immediately following the date agreed upon, at three times of the bank rate notified by the Reserve Bank of India. The bank rate notified by the Reserve Bank of India being 5.50% per annum at the relevant time, the interest payable by you is at 16.50% per annum with monthly rests.

7. That the principal amount due and payable by you is Rs 11,20,000/- (Rupees Eleven Lakh Twenty Thousand only), and interest accrued thereon up to 15 October 2026 as per the aforesaid computation is Rs 1,15,600/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifteen Thousand Six Hundred only), making a total of Rs 12,35,600/- (Rupees Twelve Lakh Thirty-Five Thousand Six Hundred only). Interest shall continue to accrue on the principal amount till the date of actual payment.

8. That I hereby call upon you, by this notice, to pay to my client within fifteen (15) days of the receipt of this notice, that is, on or before 31 October 2026, the sum of Rs 12,35,600/- being the principal amount of Rs 11,20,000/- and interest of Rs 1,15,600/- accrued up to 15 October 2026, together with further compound interest at three times the bank rate till realisation, by way of RTGS to my client's account, the details of which are given below:

Beneficiary: Ganesh Steel Components; Account No. 0012 3456 7890; IFSC RMCB0000000.

9. That in case you fail to comply with the demand made in this notice within the aforesaid period, my client has instructed me to make a reference to the Micro and Small Enterprises Facilitation Council ("MSEFC"), Rajkot / Gujarat, under Section 18 of the MSMED Act, 2006, for conciliation and arbitration, wherein you will be liable, in addition to the principal and interest, to pay the costs of the proceedings. Under Section 19 of the Act, you shall not be entitled to apply to a court for setting aside any decree, award or order made by the Council unless you have deposited seventy-five per cent (75%) of the amount awarded.

10. That the notice cost of Rs 11,000/- is also payable by you. Please treat this notice as served upon you for compliance within the stipulated period of fifteen (15) days, failing which my client shall proceed as stated above without further notice, at your risk as to costs and consequences.

Yours faithfully,
